verdicts.note: Internal controls and oversight of public funds are the treasurer's core custody duties, and both candidates promise them in nearly the same words [S2][S3]. Neither source states a view on restraining versus expanding county spending, which the treasurer does not set. The direction toward pole_a is literal ('oversight') rather than a policy stance, so low confidence.
